description: Data associated with manuscript: "An investigation of how context affects the response of pedestrians to the movement of others" in Safety Science. This dataset contains information on the movement of human participants and their answers to some questions inside a three-dimensional virtual environment. Please refer to the associated publication for details on the study and data analysis.
